title: Warm Smoky Greek Cheese Flatbread
description: A smoky and aerated Greek dish featuring cheese and render fat, perfect for a midnight craving, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: flatbread
ingredients.notes: preferably whole wheat or gluten free

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together crumbled feta cheese, pitted kalamata olives, canned artichoke hearts, and chopped sun dried tomatoes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together rendered lamb fat, smoked paprika, and garlic powder.
Brush the flatbread pieces with the lamb fat mixture on both sides.
Place the flatbread pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spoon the feta cheese mixture evenly over the flatbread pieces.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until the flatbread is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
